sentences.en: The most beloved people in the world are the spontaneous.
sentences.zh: 世界上最受爱戴的人是那些率性而为的人。

sentences.en: Nothing is as beloved as what one gets for free.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比免费得到的东西更令人喜爱的了。

sentences.en: Nothing is as beloved as what one does in vain.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比徒劳无功的努力更让人珍惜的了。

senses.zh: 深爱的，心爱的；受喜爱的，深受欢迎的
